title: changelog-overrides
description: Editorial overrides that release-kit applies to generated changelog items. Each key is a lowercase hex commit hash or prefix, which targets every item of the commit, optionally followed by `:<n>`, which targets the item derived from the commit's `n`th change-record entry.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

^[0-9a-f]+(:[1-9][0-9]*)?$.description: Override for the items that the key targets. At least one field must be set.

audience.description: `skip` removes the items. `all` and `dev` are reserved and not yet supported.

breaking.description: Sets whether the item is marked as breaking.
